name: abl_attn_pool_kcat_km
description: v5b residue attention-pool (RankBind's best BRENDA-200 config, MRR 0.427) transferred to the BRENDA+SABIO kcat/Km decoy-augmented dataset. Tests whether the BEST model generalises beyond BRENDA-200, not just the v4 mean-pool recipe. Model block copied verbatim from abl_attn_pool.json (learned single-head attention pool over per-residue ESM2 + bilinear head rank=128); data block inherited from datasets/kcat_km_with_decoys.json. hard_pool_size scaled to 1400 (~50% of train proteins), matching the v4 kcat_km sweep peak in paper Table tab:hpsweep.

_notes.role: kcat_km-scale generalisation test of the v5b attn_pool head (best model). Single-seed (42) like the v4 transfer runs.
_notes.hard_pool_size_rationale: 1400 ~= 50% of the kcat_km train-protein pool; mirrors the v4 sweep peak for this dataset (paper Table tab:hpsweep).
